messages.subject: MCAR in INLA
parts:
Hi, guys,

Does the R-INLA support the multivariate conditional autoregressive model now? One post in 2015 said not. Any progress now?

Thanks
Sunny

messages.author: b453c29749de564d
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] MCAR in INLA
parts:
On Wed, 2016-09-14 at 12:10 -0700, Chenhui Liu wrote:
> Hi, guys,
>
> Does the R-INLA support the multivariate conditional autoregressive
> model now? One post in 2015 said not. Any progress now?
>

Hi

yes, we make progress. the problem is with the 'mcar' models that there
are so many variants and ways of doing the parmetersisation. it is now
very easy to implement these yourself, using R, using the new generic
model; see inla.doc("rgeneric").

make sure to use a good scale for the hyperparmeters...

Best
H
